style.description.default: Design language. Material 3 is the default and writes no attribute.
style.description.zh-CN: 切换主题的设计语言。Material 3 为默认值，此时不写属性。

fieldStyle.description.default: Filled or outlined text fields and selects. Only meaningful in Material 3.
fieldStyle.description.zh-CN: 输入框与下拉框的填充 / 描边样式。只在 Material 3 下可选。

seed.description.default: Generates the whole Material 3 palette from this color. The default matches the built-in palette.
seed.description.zh-CN: 用这个颜色生成整套 Material 3 调色板。默认值与内置色板一致。
